body:
`auto-merge.yml` gathers PR metadata, the file list and the diff through
separate live API calls, then calls `gh pr merge --auto --squash` without
`--match-head-commit`. A push landing between validation and arming means the
arm applies to a head that was never validated -- the forbidden-path scan,
the tier-2 size caps and the sensitive-diff scan all ran against the old one.

Raised by the cross-family review of #1521 and deliberately left out of that
change, which was scoped to the base branch. Fixing it properly means deciding
what should happen when the head moves mid-evaluation: `--match-head-commit`
makes arming fail rather than silently re-target, and that failure needs a
handler, or every PR that gets a push while CI is queued starts reporting a
scary error.

`gh pr merge` supports `--match-head-commit <oid>`. The metadata call already
returns `headRefOid`, so the value is in hand; the work is threading it through
and deciding the failure behaviour.

Note the window is narrow and the same-repo/fork check bounds who can drive it.
title: auto-merge arms without pinning the validated head (TOCTOU)
